top_deficiency_types.title: Have a complete alarm system manually initiated and initiated by fire sprinkler system connection.
Have simulated fire drills held at unexpected times.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Install an approved automatic sprinkler system.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
